name: Teco-vLLM on TecoOrigin SDAA
description: AccelMark runner for TecoOrigin SDAA accelerators using Teco-vLLM. Presents SDAA as CUDA-compatible; no device flag. BF16/FP16; FP8 unsupported. GPTQ/INT8; SDAA interconnect tensor parallelism.
notes: Not yet smoke-tested. Obtain the Teco-vLLM wheel / Docker image from TecoOrigin (proprietary); requirements.txt adds benchmark deps only.
